metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Vayaan Labs

plugins.name: cache-maxxer
plugins.description: Shows the prompt cache's countdown and hit rate above the input box, explains every cache break and cache expiry, and can keep the cache warm to cut Claude Code cost

plugins.name: looks
plugins.description: Five living dark themes for the Claude desktop app's Code tab, switched with /look: Glass, Universe, Queen's Necklace, True Black and Lake, with cues for what Claude is doing and a dawn that follows the context
